artifact.name: cli-team-soak-windows-latest-1
artifact.checkoutEvidence: Report verifies expected HEAD/tree/source bytes and clean tracked worktree on exact1e; no ignored or untracked source overrides.

failure.error: distributed queue did not reach a clean terminal state
failure.unexpectedRetryError: fatal: failed to read '.git/worktrees/team-soak-0-4247034327-e683ffe9ca34aeaa-task-002-55d35b3a7733449f/locked': No such file or directory
failure.explanation: 5 intended tasks plus 2 deliberately crashed starts exactly consume the configured 7-start allowance. An additional retried task-003 Git registry read failure consumed the seventh start before task-004 could start. Four successful tasks and one failed-but-settled attempt account for tasksSettled=5; two crash attempts account for the remaining starts. Earlier worker-execution assertion passed because failure attempts also count as executions.
notFailureCause: No live model or network required
Totals.rounds=0 means no completed verified round, not no task activity

sourceMechanism: Exact1e worktree-isolator.js:174 executes git worktree list --porcelain once. repositoryManagementContext:180 invokes it; createWorktree:424 invokes that context before add and :476 after add.

Exact1e git-integration.js:87 invokes git argv with shell:false. On nonzero status it uses trimmed stderr, falling back to trimmed stdout only if stderr is absent; it throws and discards partial porcelain output. opts.input is only forwarded when supplied; readRegisteredWorktrees supplies none.

Observed CI Git version is 2.55.0.windows.5. Matching tagged upstream worktree.c:311 checks file_exists(locked), then strbuf_read_file, and die_errno on failure at :315. builtin/worktree.c:978 calls that function while printing --porcelain. builtin/worktree.c:528 writes an initializing lock during add and :601-604 removes it after preparation. Concurrent add finishing between the existence check and read can generate the exact observed ENOENT.

Exact1e team-runner.js:2751 sends failure.message to registry.fail with retryable true unless explicitly false. team-distributed-queue.js:5177 increments tasksStarted per successful claim, :5041 counts settled failures as settlements, and :2745 returns max-tasks when starts reach limit. Soak sets maxTasks=fixture.tasks.length+options.crashes at :2299.
mechanismLimits: The CI artifact has the task error but no underlying Git call stack or filesystem trace. It cannot distinguish the pre-add from post-add registry call or identify the precise unlinking process.
Upstream source establishes the possible TOCTOU mechanism matching the observed error; this review did not reproduce an actual concurrent Git race or rerun the soak.

mockRegression.method: Extracted functions from exact1e and separately captured pre-existing working diff; mocked subprocess failures. No real race reproduced, no product tests modified, no soak rerun.
